_comment: The Lamp Watch (update 'The Lamp Watch', docs/WORLD.md): once per calendar day the player lights the Brindlewick lighthouse lamp. Each lit night one lost Spirling follows the light and can be answered with the Echo call outside battle (no fight, so the act bands stay as they are). Nights 1-7 are fixed and each brings a page of Mirela's lamp log; '@starter_a' and '@starter_b' are the two storm Spirlings the player did not pick. After night 7 a visitor of the pool comes each night. Missing a day costs nothing: only lit nights count. Visitors are Veydal base forms (base total 287-322), Ring = best team Ring - ring_below, at least ring_min. Scripts: scripts/core/LampWatch.gd, Overworld._action_lamp_watch.

lines: %s comes in from the dark and settles by the lamp.
It is one of the three from the storm night. It fled the lightning.
log: 'Night one. Aldo says a lamp is for boats.'
'But a Spirling came to the glass tonight. Alone.'

lines: %s lands on the railing outside the glass.
The last one from the storm night. It has circled the tower ever since.
log: 'Night two. Lost ones see a light from far away.'
'Glim found me like that, years ago. Soaked and shaking.'

lines: %s crawls onto the sill. A frayed ribbon is tied around it.
It answers to 'Button'. Whoever named it is gone.
log: 'Night three. This one wore a ribbon.'
'Someone loved it once, and then they were gone.'

lines: %s waits on the top step. It makes no sound at all.
Its Wayfarer walked into a Rift and did not come back.
log: 'Night four. The quiet ones come too.'
'They do not call. You have to call first.'

lines: %s drips ink on the floor. Its back is full of thumbprints.
It waited for years at a map house that burned down.
log: 'Night five. Aldo, if you read this: keep it lit.'
'Even when I am late. Especially then.'

lines: %s plays two notes outside, again and again.
A child taught it that song. The child grew up and left.
log: 'Night six. Every lost bond leaves a call nobody answers.'
'A lamp is not much. But it is an answer.'

lines: Something bright stitches through the dark: %s.
It has no name and no Wayfarer. It came for you.
log: 'Night seven. Tomorrow I draw where the light cannot reach.'
'Keep the lamp lit for whoever comes. M.'

pool_lines: A lost %s follows the beam across the lake.
It has nobody to go home to.
